expectations.text: The deck says the onboarding flow shipped in Q3 2026, not Q2, without presenting both conflicting versions as unresolved.
expectations.evidence: Slide 2: 'Shipped the new onboarding flow - live since August 2026' (Q3), no Q2 mention left dangling.

expectations.text: The deck does not confidently present a specific NPS number as verified fact - it flags it, omits it, or asks.
expectations.evidence: Slide 4 shows 'TBD | NPS - Q3 2026' with explanatory text that the real figure needs dashboard confirmation; no invented 38.

expectations.text: The ticket-volume KPI is presented with a short takeaway connecting it to the onboarding launch and/or hire.
expectations.evidence: Slide 3: 412->290, -30% QoQ, with takeaway text attributing the drop to the onboarding flow plus the additional support hire.

expectations.text: The deck is written so a teammate who wasn't in the retro could follow it unaided.
